name: 黃正民
objective: 各種時域響應之電腦繪圖，矩陣各項特性分析與應用，根值軌跡圖，波德圖，奈奎士圖，PID 控制器之設計，Lead-Lag 補償器之設計，控制器時域及頻域分析，控制器在狀態空間之設計，實例探討，書報研讀。
課程進度(1-16週):
Week1: Introduction
Week2: Matlab Tutorial
Week3: Simulink Tutorial
Week4: Modeling in the Frequency Domain and Time Domain 
Week5: Time Response, Stability, Steady-State Errors
Week6: Root Locus Techniques and Frequency Response Techniques
Week7: PID Controller Design
Week8: Arduino Embedded System Applications
Week9: Midterm exam
Week10: Motor Control Applications
Week11: Motor Control Applications
Week12: Motor Control Applications
Week13: Motor Control Applications
Week14: Motor Control Applications
Week15: Robotic Applications
Week16: Robotic Applications
Week17: Robotic Applications
Week18: Final Project
